frequency_question: How often do principals with the statutory authority to raise an idle countercyclical capital buffer actually deploy an initial positive setting within a typical multi-year mandate window?
membership_rule: Members are major central banks/regulators with a formal CCyB framework implemented post-2010 who have kept the buffer at 0% for an extended baseline period. Excluded are countries that systematically maintain a permanent positive neutral rate or lack independent macroprudential boards.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB

provenance_note: 6 cases named, 12 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.0x)
coverage_note: 12 major jurisdictions tracked; 5 observed activations from a zero baseline.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging markets with idiosyncratic macroprudential frameworks.
skeleton: G7 peers and advanced economies with Basel III implementation frameworks observed over 3 distinct economic expansion cycles.
multiplier: 5 countries initiating positive CCyB settings out of approximately 12 major advanced jurisdictions with discretion over the tool over a 15-year horizon.
validity_reason: Basel III structural capital frameworks change slowly over multi-year regulatory regimes.
